10 REM! INTEGER I
20 DIM P%(12),A%(11)
30 DEF FN F(Z)=M%
40 Y%=A:COLOR=M%
50 W$=RIGHT$(Q1$,100<A<>36536):SPEED=A:COLOR=ATN(P%(A%(M%)+127))
60 GOTO 80
70 VTAB AB%
80 SPEED=M%:C=PEEK(AB%)<>I:IF P%(ASC(W$))+SQR(PEEK(Z%)) THEN Q1$="TASC"
90 C=A%(M%) OR FN F(M%+AB%):M%=256:HLIN COS(AB%),P%(M%>((A<>Z%))) AT ((731-I OR 20>=7))*C
100 XY=LEN(MID$(Y$,1)) OR A:PRINT LEFT$(LEFT$(W$,65535-5),-((C/P%(255)))),Z%,:PRINT LEFT$(Y$,M%)+LEFT$(W$,1)+"";1,
110 AB%=1
120 Y%=5
130 A=C:CALL P%(INT(828/2)):RESTORE
140 IF 7 THEN PLOT A,Z%
150 M%=SGN(100-((P%(Y%)<A))):PRINT RIGHT$(RIGHT$(W$,B)+""+"",XY+A=A%(Y%));STR$(694^TAN(A%(5))):PRINT I/VAL(W$)-I/-5;
160 Y%=SGN(1E3>=Z%)
170 Y%=24
180 HLIN P%(PEEK(AB)),-10+256<>((I<A<>P%(916)*Y%)) AT ((B>P%(M%)))-AB%:FOR A=Z% TO XY:PRINT Y$;W$+MID$(Y$,C)+W$,SQR(-ATN(AB%))
190 PRINT:GOTO 210:INPUT Y%
200 IF FN F(7) THEN 180:Y$=MID$(W$,1.5,23880<-I):I=RND(SQR(3))/((-343*5))
210 I=A%(-A%(M%)):Y$=MID$(Y$,INT(XY<B),-((0 OR M%)))
220 DATA 300,HI,1
230 RETURN:AB=7:HTAB NOT ((-M%))
240 IF XY THEN 170
250 P%(((Y%*A%(1E3)<>-XY))*1)=PEEK(3):AB=Z%
260 C=A%(AB%)<((2<0))-NOT B:A%(Y%)=B
270 DATA X,"A,B":ON COS(0) GOTO 260,50,200
280 GOSUB 250
290 A=NOT ((M%<=I))
300 IF Y%<((A>=ASC("HI"))) THEN HLIN AB%+-Y%+-I,TAN(970)-((M%+AB%))<LEN("X Y") AT XY:PRINT:IF INT(Z%) THEN 250
310 Y$=""
